observations.why: Imperative directive issued as a settled instruction the speaker expects carried out — performed declarative settling, not an argued-for position.
Operational imperative with 'all' scoping — the speaker is instructing a concrete, load-bearing action, not asserting a debatable position.
Flat unhedged factual assertion presented as established — claim-level conviction: asserted and ready to defend, but no performed ratification or operational settling to lift it to decision.
